stories.title: Federal appeals court temporarily blocks controlled detonation of lead azide at Middletown, Iowa US Army plant after being postponed
stories.summary: The temporary stay pauses the emergency permit until the appeals court rules on the request from the Iowa Environmental Council and Sierra Club for a longer-term halt.

stories.title: One Table Fresno returns with meals, coats and holiday groceries for families in need
stories.summary: Thousands of Valley families are expected to receive holiday support this weekend as the sixth annual One Table Fresno returns to City Center.

stories.title: Good Sports: Merced High School's continued water polo success
stories.summary: Even with the temperatures cooling down, the Merced High School Bears are right where they want to be. In the pool, instead of hibernating.

stories.title: Nearly 10,000 pounds of lead azide to be detonated at Iowa Army plant, causing lead dust plume into Illinois
stories.summary: Two rapid controlled detonations scheduled to take place at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown on Friday have been postponed by three days.

stories.title: UnitedHealthcare to eliminate prior authorization for over 2,000 pediatric care codes
stories.summary: UnitedHealthcare announced it will reduce pediatric prior authorization requirements, eliminating the need for approval on more than 2,000 pediatric care codes.

stories.title: Dolores Huerta honored during celebration of life in Bakersfield
stories.summary: Hundreds gathered Friday morning at Dignity Health Arena in downtown Bakersfield to honor Dolores Huerta during a celebration of life marked by prayer, music and tributes to her decades of activism.

stories.title: Tornado Warning expires for southwest Merced County, National Weather Service says
stories.summary: The Tornado Warning issued for southwest Merced County has expired.

stories.title: Federal jury convicts man of starting the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles
stories.summary: The man accused of sparking last year's deadly Palisades Fire was found guilty of arson charges Friday after his first federal case earlier this year ended in a mistrial.

stories.title: New government report sparks concern over potential cyberattack on US food supply
stories.summary: One system affected is a tool for farmer payments, a source said.

stories.title: Court approves $7.25 billion settlement with Bayer over claims Roundup weed killer caused cancer
stories.summary: Bayer will pay up to $7.25 billion over two decades to settle thousands of U.S. claims related to its weed killer, Roundup.

stories.title: Final preparations for annual Fiesta Navideña event
stories.summary: Fiesta Navideña has been raising funds for scholarships for 50 years. The event not only celebrates culture and community but also invests in students.

stories.title: Judge denies Alex Murdaugh's bid to dismiss murder charges
stories.summary: Murdaugh sought to throw out the case as he faces a retrial, after the South Carolina Supreme Court overturned his 2023 murder convictions.
